# fast boot (test only): Vice (stadium 13, the menus' default stadium), Donkey Kong v Waluigi, the game's default options: the tour's walk-out, 62 s of play, a goal sequence
# Run: emu.sh <tag> <vpk> <this file> <seconds> <routes/fb-tour.txt>   (the route is the console-1.2 route tour.txt, from its `wait ingame == 1` line on)
# ---- the fast boot is switched on by the route's first line (`bootmatch vice:3:6 ...`): in the emulator the Vita build's env file did not deliver MSC_BOOT_MATCH ----
# ---- route and logging: as the console-1.2 reference runs ----
MSC_INPUT_SCRIPT=ux0:data/mscharged-perf-test/fb-tour.txt
MSC_FRAME_TIMING=300
MSC_LAT=1
MSC_WATCH=1
MSC_WATCH_EVERY=600
MSC_VITA_RENDER=320x224
